question: Which of the following is NOT any position in the Basketball sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**All rounder**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**All rounder**" is not a standard position in basketball.
 
• The term is more commonly used in cricket to describe a player who is skilled both in batting and bowling.
 
• In basketball, the typical positions are:
 
 
• **Point guard **– The player who runs the team's offense and is usually the **primary ball handler**.
 
• **Shooting guard **– A player who is generally a **good scorer**, especially from long-range.
 
• **Small forward **– A versatile player who can play **both offensive and defensive** roles, often responsible for scoring and defending.
